# Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (RACGP)

> RACGP is Australia's peak body for general practice, providing clinical resources, professional development, and employment services for GPs and healthcare practitioners.

The RACGP website serves as a central hub for Australian general practitioners, offering access to peer-reviewed clinical literature, professional membership services, and job placement through recruitGP. The organization supports evidence-based practice, cultural safety, preventive healthcare, and digital health innovation across Australia's primary care sector.

## Key Topics

- General Practice
- Australian Journal of General Practice (AJGP)
- Clinical Updates
- Preventive Healthcare
- General Practitioner Positions
- recruitGP Job Board
- Medical Careers
- Healthcare Policy
- Digital Health
- Aboriginal Health
- Vaccination
- Cultural Safety
- Primary Care
- Professional Development
- Australia Healthcare

## Membership & Professional Services

- [RACGP Membership Selector](https://www1.racgp.org.au/members/forms/membership-selector): Tool to help practitioners select appropriate RACGP membership category

## Clinical Publications & Research

- [Australian Journal of General Practice (AJGP)](https://www1.racgp.org.au/ajgp): Australian Journal of General Practice home with evidence-based articles
- [AJGP March 2026 Issue](https://www1.racgp.org.au/ajgp/2026/march): AJGP March 2026 issue with clinical guidance and preventive healthcare
- [AJGP Subscription](https://www1.racgp.org.au/ajgp/subscribe): AJGP subscription page for journal access and membership

## Employment & Career Services

- [recruitGP Job Board](https://www1.racgp.org.au/recruitgp/home): recruitGP job board for general practice employment across Australia
- [recruitGP Search](https://www1.racgp.org.au/recruitGP): recruitGP job board for general practice employment across Australia
